ghi_chu: Muc de GOP vao survey/facts_phase2.json (khoa: C2_ablation_bo_B1). Tach file rieng de tranh ghi de khi nhieu tien trinh cung sua facts_phase2.json.

C2_ablation_bo_B1.nguon: model/train_12.py -> model/train_12.json (6/6 fold + production_12); benchmark_dpss/eval_12.py -> eval_12.json (gop tu eval_12_b1.json + eval_12_cinc.json); analysis/ablation_b1.py -> analysis/ABLATION_B1.md + ablation_b1_results.json
C2_ablation_bo_B1.cau_hoi: Cai thien 5 -> 22 chu the la do THEM DU LIEU hay do mo hinh hoc PHONG CACH NHAN GIAN TIEP cua B1 (incorporation bias)?
C2_ablation_bo_B1.thiet_ke: m12 = huan luyen tren 12 chu the CHI co nhan dien cuc da dau (5 PhysioNet + 7 B2 khong trung), KHONG he thay B1. Moi thu khac giong het train_22.py (4 epoch, seed 0, cung tang cuong, cung tien xu ly 10-60 Hz).

12_chu_the_nhan_vang_giu_lai_nhom.ghi_chu: m12 moi fold hoc tu 9 chu the, m22 moi fold hoc tu 19 -- van hoa nhau

dau_van_nhan_tren_B1.dinh_nghia: do lech thoi diem tuyet doi TB va jitter TB tren 8 chu the B1 ma CA BA mo hinh deu dat F1>=95 (loai B1_06, B1_07 de khong lan voi do kho)
dau_van_nhan_tren_B1.y_nghia: Mo hinh tung thay B1 trung tam voi moc cua B1 chinh xac gap doi; hai mo hinh chua tung thay lech GIONG HET nhau. Day la chu ky cua QUY UOC CHAM MOC. Voi dung sai +/-50 ms no gan nhu khong doi F1, nhung cam dung so B1 de noi ve do chinh xac thoi diem (jitter, STV).

quet_nguong_m12.ket_luan: ket luan khong phu thuoc nguong; ngay ca o nguong tot nhat cua m12 van kem m22 2,47 diem tren B1 va 3,92 diem tren CinC

C2_ablation_bo_B1.KET_LUAN: GIU ket luan 'them du lieu'. Bang chung quyet dinh: tren CinC 2013 (tap doc lap, nguoi chu thich khac, khong lien quan Silesia) m22 van hon m12 5,06 diem (p=3,8e-08) -- uu the ton tai o noi KHONG CO GI de bat chuoc. Ti le loi ich m12 lay lai gan bang nhau tren B1 (28%) va CinC (38%). Khoang cach tren B1 don vao 2 ca kho (B1_07 -19,35; B1_06 -7,36), 8/10 ca con lai chenh <=0,5 diem -- khong phai sai lech he thong kieu bat chuoc nhan.
SUA_CACH_PHAT_BIEU: Co dau van nhan THAT nhung nam o MOC THOI GIAN chu khong o F1: m22 lech 3,25 ms / jitter 3,79 ms so voi m12 6,50 / 6,62 ms tren cung 8 chu the de. => Khong duoc dung so B1 de noi ve do chinh xac thoi diem.
Tren chinh 12 chu the nhan vang, du lieu B1 KHONG giup gi (97,84 vs 97,89) -- loi ich cua B1 chi xuat hien o mien B1 va o CinC.

Giam sai so tuong doi tren B1 (49%) gap 2,5 lan tren CinC (20%): co mot thanh phan TRONG MIEN. Thiet ke nay KHONG tach duoc 'cung thiet bi/dan so' khoi 'cung nguoi cham'. Muon tach phai co tap thai ky 20 phut cham bang dien cuc da dau -- hien chua co cong khai.
C2_ablation_bo_B1.gioi_han: m12 production hoc 12 chu the / m22 fold hoc 19 -> gop ca so luong lan nguon goc du lieu; chi 1 seed (bien thien seed da do: 0,28 diem TB); nguong production_12 = 0,80 (trung vi nguong fold co san luc do), trung vi cua ca 6 fold la 0,52 -- da quet nguong de chung minh khong doi ket luan.
C2_ablation_bo_B1.thoi_gian: 6 fold + production_12 chay 3 luong song song, moi luong 1 nhan CPU; fold ~21-23 phut/fold, production 31 phut; eval B1 3,1 phut, eval CinC 75 ban ghi 1,4 phut.
